CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content found.

COD.rationale: Content (red at a coordinate), its presentation (coordinate mapping), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colours ('red','blue') bound to coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/metadata explicitly distinguish content identity from provenance/status (copied_prior_record vs history_estimate etc.).

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented (coordinate assignments per node) and the grid orientation.
